item.title: Version 1.2.31 (Build 20261126.1)
item.description:
What's New

perf(telex): keep the literal guard off the keystroke hot path

The early literal guard added in 6e85962 ran the word string build, the

user/dictionary lookups and a file-attribute stat (isDictionaryLoaded ->

FileManager.attributesOfItem) on every keystroke before the structural

check — 18.01 us/keystroke vs the 6.6 us perf gate (baseline 2.19).

  • Run deadStateReason() first; only a structurally dead word pays for the

word string and dictionary lookups. Decisions are unchanged: guard still

fires on dead ∧ letters>=2 ∧ not a dictionary/user-dictionary word.

  • Drop the isDictionaryLoaded stat: isValidWord already checks the user

dictionary and returns false when no dictionary is loaded.

  • Precompute valid prefixes of endConsonantTable and validSequences into

static sets instead of rebuilding arrays per table row per keystroke.

Measured after: ~2.3 us/keystroke (0.23 s per 100k keys), Release gate

green; Debug suite and XKeyIM build pass.

Ships as 1.2.31 (20261126.1): v1.2.30 already went out with the regression.
